kind: 平台适配补丁集（不是完整引擎树）
engine_variant: gfx928 / DTK 26.04 / clang 17 / NATIVE_EXPERTS=ON（含 ggml CPU 专家通道）
reference: upstream niko1221/strata main（取于 2026-10-31，源码内 STRATA_VERSION="0.1.55"）
build_env_note: DTK 的 HSA 头在 /opt/dtk/.hyhal/include/hsa，hip-lang 的 CMake 包找 /opt/dtk/include/hsa；容器内补软链（脚本已含）。
patches_note: patches/0006-mfma-attention.patch is the opt-in matrix-core port (MMAC on gfx928, MFMA on CDNA); it is not part of the recorded baseline build. It was built and validated on the K100_AI box (layout gate + 16-token ids), but the controlled A/B/A/B showed no prefill speedup and the all-position KL has a caveat: see mfma_attention below.

startup.requires: source /opt/dtk/env.sh（否则 dlopen libhsa-runtime64 失败）

numerics_gate.tolerances: token gate_up 1e-5, token down 1e-6, set gate_up 1e-2, set down 3e-3
numerics_gate.cpu_lane: 同类型同容差全部 ok（与 ggml 解码 + 双精度参考一致）

not_verified: 模型加载与整模型推理（本目录不含权重，官方 2.00bpw 需 138 GB + Engram 111 GB + DSpark 8 GB）
注意力 / 路由 / 超连接 / 长上下文的整模型数值（ds4_iq_test 只覆盖 i-quant 专家内核）
真实专家规模下的显存与内存分层
32K 提示词的 A/B（4K/10K 已做；10K 最好也只有约 +2.8%）
全 prompt 位置的 KL 0.006 门槛（last-position 0.00131 通过，全位置平均 0.0255 不通过）
字节级可复现（clean_rebuild_verified 为 false）
known_traps: gfx928 没有 MFMA：DTK 26.04 / clang 17 对 __builtin_amdgcn_mfma_f32_16x16x16f16 报 "needs target feature mai-insts"；gfx928 的矩阵核是 MMAC（__builtin_amdgcn_mmac_f32_16x16x16f16，V_MMAC_F32_16X16X16_F16）。0006 补丁在 gfx928 上按 MMAC 实现，CDNA 才走 MFMA
DS4_FAST_ATTN=1 的布局门和 ids 已过，但**4K A/B/A/B 没有速度收益，10K 最好也只有约 +2.8%**，且 KL 门槛有保留：全 prompt 位置平均 0.0255，last-position 0.00131；默认不开启，也不建议生产启用
只挂 renderD128 或未挂宿主机 HyHAL 时卡被识别为 KONGMING，HIP 报 no ROCm-capable device

mfma_attention.status: implemented and validated on K100_AI (gfx928, MMAC): layout gate ALL OK, ids identical; 4K A/B/A/B shows no prefill gain, 10K shows at best about +2.8%, and all-prompt-position KL is not under the 0.006 bar
mfma_attention.apply_order: after the baseline (patches/0001..0005 or tools/patches-wip/baseline-gfx928-port.patch); on the production tree also after tools/patches-wip/expert-index-tp.patch, then this patch
mfma_attention.what: gfx928's matrix core is MMAC, not MFMA: sparse_attn_wmma_kernel uses __builtin_amdgcn_mmac_f32_16x16x16f16 (C row = lane&15, col = (lane>>4)+4i); the CDNA parts keep MFMA. Two 16x16 tiles a wave, 32 keys a tile, 4 waves x 128 dims; gfx11/gfx12 WMMA unchanged; DS4_FAST_ATTN stays opt-in on gfx9

files_after_patch.change: new (MMAC on gfx928, MFMA on CDNA)
modified (adds the ds4_mfma_test target on a matrix-core architecture)

checks: one V_MMAC/V_MFMA 16x16x16 step on the device's map

cpu_model.what: the MMAC branch's bookkeeping (C row=lane&15, col=(lane>>4)+4i; 4 waves, 32-key stage, 16 tiles with a partial last, online softmax, both products) against a plain attention reference
cpu_model.result: max abs 2.7e-4, mean 2.6e-5 on 500 keys (16 tiles, last partial)

validated_on_box.not_in_patch: the validated binary came from strata-exp = baseline + expert-index-tp + 0006. Its earlier K100AI T==1 decode 8-row prefetch is part of expert-index-tp.patch, not 0006; it is decode-only, does not run on the T=512 prefill slab, and the MMAC device kernel is line-identical between the validated tree and 0006.
validated_on_box.build_source: the all-changes build (build-all) was made from strata-exp + 0006. A clean v029 + baseline + probe patches + expert-index-tp still rejects one ds4_model.cu hunk because expert-index-tp expects the local probe base; reproduce by copying the two working trees (tools/patches-wip/README.md).
validated_on_box.instruction_discovery: the DTK clang rejects __builtin_amdgcn_mfma_f32_16x16x16f16 on gfx928 ('needs target feature mai-insts'); gfx928 has __builtin_amdgcn_mmac_f32_16x16x16f16 and V_MMAC_F32_16X16X16_F16 (/opt/dtk/include/du_mma.hpp gives the lane map). A raw one-step probe matched the CPU product with 0 mismatches; random-value precision was 1.75e-7 (one step) / 2.05e-6 (16 steps) max absolute vs FP64.
validated_on_box.layout_test: matrix-core layout test: ALL OK (one step + mma_scores + mma_pv, 0 mismatches each)

prefill_ab.env: DS4_EXPERT_TP=1 DS4_AR_RS2=1 DS4_ATTN_SPLIT=1, --tp 2 --dspark none --mmap-experts on, same binary
prefill_ab.order: warm-up then scalar, MMAC, scalar, MMAC (A/B/A/B)
prefill_ab.result: no speedup: the best MMAC run (97.3 s) is about 2% slower than the scalar runs (95.1-95.5 s); one MMAC outlier (114.6 s) makes the median worse
prefill_ab.note: the earlier single 118187 -> 97096 ms pair was a cold first run and is retracted; it is not an A/B

prefill_ab_10k.order: warm-up then scalar, MMAC, scalar, MMAC (A/B/A/B)
prefill_ab_10k.result: best MMAC is about 2.8% faster (260.1 vs 267.5 s); the scalar 294.7 s outlier widens the median but this is far from the design's +30-45%
prefill_ab_10k.note: the 10K warm-up scalar produced different ids (2337,344) from the four comparable runs (32111,377); treated as a cold-start anomaly, not part of the comparison

validated_on_box.ids: 4k prompt, 16 greedy tokens: 671,6102,294,8760,344,11111,16,1 identical for scalar and MMAC; 10k prompt, 2 tokens: the four comparable runs all give 32111,377; the 17-token prompt gives 671,6102,294,8760 (the short run uses the window path, not the fast path)
validated_on_box.fast_path_log: with --window 512, 560 launches logged 'ds4: fast attn T=512 heads=32 gen=1'

kl.note: the last-position logits (the generation oracle) are under 0.006; the mean over every prompt position is not. Most positions are bit-identical (median KL 7.7e-7); a subset (592) diverges, so this is not plain FP16 rounding.
